heading.en: The delivery van for a gene

hook.en: A gene on its own is like a parcel without an address. A vector carries it into the host cell, makes copies, and even tells us which cells received it.
hook.kn: ಜೀನ್ ಒಂಟಿಯಾಗಿ ವಿಳಾಸವಿಲ್ಲದ ಪಾರ್ಸೆಲ್‌ನಂತೆ. ವಾಹಕವು ಅದನ್ನು ಆತಿಥೇಯ ಕೋಶಕ್ಕೆ ಒಯ್ದು ಪ್ರತಿಗಳನ್ನು ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ ಮತ್ತು ಯಾವ ಕೋಶಗಳು ಅದನ್ನು ಪಡೆದವು ಎಂದೂ ತಿಳಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

objectives.en: List the features of a cloning vector using pBR322
Explain insertional inactivation and blue-white selection
Describe ways of making host cells take up DNA

narration.en: A gene on its own is like a parcel without an address. A vector carries it into the host cell, makes copies, and even tells us which cells received it.
narration.kn: ಜೀನ್ ಒಂಟಿಯಾಗಿ ವಿಳಾಸವಿಲ್ಲದ ಪಾರ್ಸೆಲ್‌ನಂತೆ. ವಾಹಕವು ಅದನ್ನು ಆತಿಥೇಯ ಕೋಶಕ್ಕೆ ಒಯ್ದು ಪ್ರತಿಗಳನ್ನು ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ ಮತ್ತು ಯಾವ ಕೋಶಗಳು ಅದನ್ನು ಪಡೆದವು ಎಂದೂ ತಿಳಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.

body.en: Plasmids and bacteriophages replicate inside bacterial cells independently of the chromosomal DNA, so they are used as vectors. A cloning vector needs: (a) an origin of replication (ori), which also controls the copy number of the linked DNA; (b) a selectable marker, which helps identify and eliminate non-transformants and select transformants, usually genes for resistance to antibiotics such as ampicillin, chloramphenicol, tetracycline or kanamycin (normal E. coli cells resist none of these); (c) cloning sites, preferably a single recognition site for each commonly used restriction enzyme, because several sites would cut the vector into many fragments. In the E. coli vector pBR322, rop codes for proteins involved in plasmid replication, and there are restriction sites for Hind III, EcoR I, BamH I, Sal I, Pvu II, Pst I and Cla I, plus ampR and tetR genes.

points.en: ori: start of replication, controls copy number
Single cloning site for each enzyme
pBR322: ori, rop, ampR, tetR, 7 restriction sites

narration.en: A good vector has an origin of replication, a selectable marker such as an antibiotic-resistance gene, and single recognition sites for the restriction enzymes we use. pBR322 has ori, rop, ampR, tetR and sites like BamH I and EcoR I.
narration.kn: ಉತ್ತಮ ವಾಹಕದಲ್ಲಿ ಪ್ರತಿಕೃತಿ ಆರಂಭ ಸ್ಥಾನ, ಪ್ರತಿಜೀವಕ-ನಿರೋಧಕ ಜೀನಿನಂತಹ ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಗುರುತು ಮತ್ತು ಪ್ರತಿ ಕಿಣ್ವಕ್ಕೆ ಒಂದೇ ಗುರುತಿನ ಸ್ಥಾನ ಇರಬೇಕು. pBR322 ನಲ್ಲಿ ori, rop, ampR, tetR ಮತ್ತು BamH I, EcoR I ನಂತಹ ಸ್ಥಾನಗಳಿವೆ.

body.en: If a foreign gene is ligated into the BamH I site of the tetracycline-resistance gene of pBR322, the recombinant plasmid loses tetracycline resistance but keeps ampicillin resistance. Transformants are first grown on ampicillin; they are then replica-plated on tetracycline: recombinants grow on ampicillin but not on tetracycline. Because this is tedious, a simpler method uses the gene for β-galactosidase: inserting the foreign DNA into its coding sequence inactivates it (insertional inactivation). On a chromogenic substrate, colonies without an insert are blue, and recombinant colonies are colourless (white). For plants, the Ti plasmid of Agrobacterium tumefaciens is modified into a vector that no longer causes tumours but still delivers genes; for animals, disarmed retroviruses are used.

points.en: Insert in tetR → recombinants grow on ampicillin, not tetracycline
Insert in β-galactosidase gene → white colonies; non-recombinants blue
Plants: disarmed Ti plasmid of Agrobacterium tumefaciens

narration.en: When a gene is inserted inside a marker gene, that marker is switched off: this is insertional inactivation. With the β-galactosidase gene, recombinant colonies stay white while non-recombinants turn blue.
narration.kn: ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಗುರುತಿನ ಜೀನಿನ ಒಳಗೆ ಹೊಸ ಜೀನ್ ಸೇರಿಸಿದಾಗ ಆ ಜೀನ್ ನಿಷ್ಕ್ರಿಯವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ: ಇದೇ ಸೇರ್ಪಡೆ ನಿಷ್ಕ್ರಿಯತೆ. β-ಗ್ಯಾಲಕ್ಟೋಸಿಡೇಸ್ ಜೀನಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಪುನರ್ಸಂಯೋಜಿತ ವಸಾಹತುಗಳು ಬಿಳಿಯಾಗಿ, ಇತರವು ನೀಲಿಯಾಗಿ ಕಾಣುತ್ತವೆ.

body.en: DNA is hydrophilic and cannot pass through cell membranes, so bacterial cells are first made competent. They are treated with a specific concentration of a divalent cation such as calcium, which increases the efficiency with which DNA enters through pores in the cell wall. The cells are incubated with recombinant DNA on ice, given a brief heat shock at 42 °C, and put back on ice. Other methods: micro-injection, in which recombinant DNA is injected directly into the nucleus of an animal cell; biolistics or the gene gun, in which plant cells are bombarded with high-velocity micro-particles of gold or tungsten coated with DNA; and "disarmed pathogen" vectors, which infect the cell and transfer the DNA.

points.en: Gene gun: gold or tungsten particles, plant cells

narration.en: DNA is water-loving and cannot cross membranes on its own. Calcium ions plus a heat shock at 42 degrees let bacteria take it up; animal cells receive it by micro-injection and plant cells by a gene gun firing DNA-coated gold or tungsten particles.
narration.kn: DNA ಜಲಪ್ರಿಯ, ತಾನಾಗಿ ಪೊರೆ ದಾಟಲಾರದು. ಕ್ಯಾಲ್ಸಿಯಂ ಅಯಾನುಗಳು ಮತ್ತು 42 ಡಿಗ್ರಿ ಉಷ್ಣಾಘಾತದಿಂದ ಬ್ಯಾಕ್ಟೀರಿಯಾ ಅದನ್ನು ಸ್ವೀಕರಿಸುತ್ತವೆ; ಪ್ರಾಣಿ ಕೋಶಗಳಿಗೆ ಸೂಕ್ಷ್ಮ ಚುಚ್ಚುಮದ್ದು, ಸಸ್ಯ ಕೋಶಗಳಿಗೆ ಚಿನ್ನ ಅಥವಾ ಟಂಗ್‌ಸ್ಟನ್ ಕಣಗಳ ಜೀನ್ ಗನ್ ಬಳಸುತ್ತಾರೆ.

problem.en: A gene is inserted at the BamH I site of pBR322 and the plasmids are put into E. coli. Colonies X, Y and Z behave as follows: X grows on ampicillin and on tetracycline; Y grows on ampicillin only; Z grows on neither. Identify each.

steps.en: BamH I lies in tetR, so an insert there destroys tetracycline resistance but leaves ampR intact.
X resists both antibiotics: it took up a plasmid with no insert (non-recombinant).
Y resists ampicillin only: its tetR is inactivated, so it is the recombinant.
Z resists nothing: it took up no plasmid (non-transformant).

answer.en: X: non-recombinant transformant; Y: recombinant; Z: non-transformant.

narration.en: Let us work through this together. A gene is inserted at the BamH I site of pBR322 and the plasmids are put into E. coli. Colonies X, Y and Z behave as follows: X grows on ampicillin and on tetracycline; Y grows on ampicillin only; Z grows on neither. Identify each.

body.en: In blue-white screening, blue colonies have a working β-galactosidase gene, so nothing was inserted. White colonies carry the insert.

narration.en: Blue means "nothing new". In blue-white screening, blue colonies have a working β-galactosidase gene, so nothing was inserted. White colonies carry the insert.
Team quiz. Talk it over in your team and agree on one answer.
narration.kn: ತಂಡ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ನಿಮ್ಮ ತಂಡದಲ್ಲಿ ಚರ್ಚಿಸಿ ಒಂದೇ ಉತ್ತರವನ್ನು ಒಪ್ಪಿಕೊಳ್ಳಿ.

points.en: Vector features: ori, selectable marker and single cloning sites.
points.kn: ವಾಹಕದ ಲಕ್ಷಣಗಳು: ori, ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಗುರುತು ಮತ್ತು ಏಕ ಕ್ಲೋನಿಂಗ್ ಸ್ಥಾನಗಳು.

points.en: Insert in tetR of pBR322 → recombinant grows on ampicillin only.
points.kn: pBR322 ನ tetR ಒಳಗೆ ಸೇರ್ಪಡೆ → ಪುನರ್ಸಂಯೋಜಿತ ಕೋಶ ಆಂಪಿಸಿಲಿನ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತ್ರ ಬೆಳೆಯುತ್ತದೆ.

points.en: Competence: Ca2+ and heat shock; also micro-injection, gene gun and disarmed pathogens.
points.kn: ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯ: Ca2+ ಮತ್ತು ಉಷ್ಣಾಘಾತ; ಜೊತೆಗೆ ಸೂಕ್ಷ್ಮ ಚುಚ್ಚುಮದ್ದು, ಜೀನ್ ಗನ್, ನಿಷ್ಕ್ರಿಯ ರೋಗಕಾರಕಗಳು.

homework.en: Draw pBR322 and label ori, rop, ampR, tetR and the BamH I and EcoR I sites.

narration.en: Recap. Vector features: ori, selectable marker and single cloning sites. Insert in tetR of pBR322 → recombinant grows on ampicillin only. Blue-white screening: recombinants are white. Competence: Ca2+ and heat shock; also micro-injection, gene gun and disarmed pathogens.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ವಾಹಕದ ಲಕ್ಷಣಗಳು: ori, ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಗುರುತು ಮತ್ತು ಏಕ ಕ್ಲೋನಿಂಗ್ ಸ್ಥಾನಗಳು. pBR322 ನ tetR ಒಳಗೆ ಸೇರ್ಪಡೆ → ಪುನರ್ಸಂಯೋಜಿತ ಕೋಶ ಆಂಪಿಸಿಲಿನ್‌ನಲ್ಲಿ ಮಾತ್ರ ಬೆಳೆಯುತ್ತದೆ. ನೀಲಿ-ಬಿಳಿ ಆಯ್ಕೆ: ಪುನರ್ಸಂಯೋಜಿತಗಳು ಬಿಳಿ. ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯ: Ca2+ ಮತ್ತು ಉಷ್ಣಾಘಾತ; ಜೊತೆಗೆ ಸೂಕ್ಷ್ಮ ಚುಚ್ಚುಮದ್ದು, ಜೀನ್ ಗನ್, ನಿಷ್ಕ್ರಿಯ ರೋಗಕಾರಕಗಳು.
